title: The Metallica Quiz
subtitle: Four rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "Metallica". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Who is Metallica's lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist?
questions.answerNote: James Hetfield co-founded the band and has been its frontman throughout its entire history.

questions.prompt: Which Metallica bassist died in a tour bus accident in 1986?
questions.answerNote: Cliff Burton died in Sweden when the band's tour bus overturned.

questions.prompt: Which 1991 album is commonly known simply as 'The Black Album'?
questions.answerNote: The self-titled 1991 album has a plain black cover, giving it its nickname.

questions.prompt: Which Metallica song reached number one in the UK singles chart?
questions.answerNote: None of Metallica's singles have topped the UK singles chart, despite huge airplay.

questions.prompt: Which guitarist replaced Dave Mustaine in Metallica in 1983?
questions.answerNote: Kirk Hammett joined shortly before their debut album Kill 'Em All and remains lead guitarist today.

questions.prompt: Which Metallica album features the song 'Master of Puppets'?
questions.answerNote: Released in 1986, Master of Puppets is often cited as one of the greatest metal albums ever made.

questions.prompt: Which bassist has played with Metallica since 2003, following Jason Newsted's departure?
questions.answerNote: Robert Trujillo, formerly of Suicidal Tendencies, remains Metallica's bassist to this day.

questions.prompt: Which 2003 Metallica documentary chronicled the making of St. Anger and internal band tensions?
questions.answerNote: Metallica: Some Kind of Monster showed the band in therapy amid recording struggles.

questions.prompt: In which year did Metallica release their most recent studio album '72 Seasons'?
questions.answerNote: 72 Seasons was released in April 2023, exploring themes of childhood and adolescence.

questions.prompt: Which Metallica drummer has been with the band since its formation in 1981?
questions.answerNote: Lars Ulrich co-founded Metallica with James Hetfield and remains the band's drummer.

questions.prompt: In which city was Metallica formed in 1981?
questions.answerNote: Lars Ulrich placed an advert in the Los Angeles paper The Recycler.

questions.prompt: Which 1988 album was Metallica's first with bassist Jason Newsted?
questions.answerNote: His bass is famously almost inaudible in the final mix.

questions.prompt: Which Metallica song's 1989 video used clips from the film Johnny Got His Gun?
questions.answerNote: It was the band's first ever promotional video.

questions.prompt: Which band did Dave Mustaine form after being thrown out of Metallica?
questions.answerNote: He formed it within weeks of being sent home from New York in 1983.

questions.prompt: Which 1996 album, with cover art by Andres Serrano, came with short haircuts?
questions.answerNote: The change of image split the band's audience at the time.

questions.prompt: Which file-sharing service did Metallica sue in 2000?
questions.answerNote: The case began after a demo of 'I Disappear' leaked before release.

questions.prompt: Which 2008 album was Metallica's first with producer Rick Rubin?
questions.answerNote: It was widely seen as a return to their thrash roots.

questions.prompt: Metallica's 2011 album 'Lulu' was a collaboration with which musician?
questions.answerNote: It grew out of a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame anniversary show.

questions.prompt: In 2013 Metallica became the first band to have played all seven continents, after a show on which one?
questions.answerNote: The show was called Freeze 'Em All and the crowd listened on headphones.

questions.prompt: Which 2016 album contained 'Hardwired' and 'Moth into Flame'?
questions.answerNote: It was their first studio album in eight years.

rounds.title: Round Three — Pick Them All
rounds.blurb: More than one answer is right. Lock in every one of them.

questions.prompt: Which three of these songs feature on the album Master of Puppets?
questions.answerNote: Battery, Master of Puppets and Welcome Home (Sanitarium) all appear on the 1986 album.

questions.prompt: Which two of these guitarists have been full members of Metallica's lineup?
questions.answerNote: Hammett has played lead guitar since 1983, and Mustaine was an original member before being fired.

questions.prompt: Which two of these songs were written or co-written for the S&M live album with an orchestra?
questions.answerNote: No Leaf Clover and -Human were both new songs written specifically for the 1999 S&M project with the San Francisco Symphony.

questions.prompt: Which three of these are songs from the 1984 album Ride the Lightning's era single releases or the album itself?
questions.answerNote: Whiplash, Seek and Destroy and Motorbreath are all from the debut Kill 'Em All instead.

questions.prompt: Which two of these are songs from the debut album Kill 'Em All?
questions.answerNote: Kill 'Em All, released in 1983, introduced the world to Metallica's raw early thrash sound.

questions.prompt: Which three of these songs feature on the 2003 album St. Anger?
questions.answerNote: St. Anger famously had no guitar solos on any track.

questions.prompt: Which two of these are Metallica live albums?
questions.answerNote: S&M was recorded with the San Francisco Symphony Orchestra.

questions.prompt: Which three of these are original founding members of Metallica?
questions.answerNote: Hetfield and Ulrich founded the band in 1981, with Dave Mustaine on guitar until he was fired in 1983.

questions.prompt: Which two of these Metallica albums were released in the 1990s?
questions.answerNote: Metallica arrived in 1991 and Load in 1995; the other four are all 1980s records.

questions.prompt: Which two of these bassists have played bass for Metallica?
questions.answerNote: This question asks about the earlier era - Burton and Newsted both played bass before Trujillo joined in 2003.
